errors.evidence: The description consistently mismatches the title length (category on the y-axis) with the number of poems (value of the bar). For example, it states the first bar (title length 1) corresponds to 1 poem, but the chart shows it corresponds to 69 poems. It also reports incorrect title lengths for most bars (e.g., '标题长度为2' which does not exist, '标题长度为4' which is also not a category for a bar). This error propagates through the entire list of bars, with incorrect categories, incorrect values, or both.
